dimensions.evidenceA: The LORD grieves that he made Saul king.
dimensions.label: Language about change

evidence.observation: The LORD says it grieves him that he made Saul king, and the chapter closes with the same grief.
evidence.role: The LORD’s words and the narrator

evidence.observation: Samuel says Israel’s Strength will not lie or repent, because he is not a man.

record.tension: One chapter places divine grief beside a statement that Israel’s Strength does not repent.
record.title: Does the LORD grieve or not repent?
